verdict.rationale: Luma's docs list image-to-video as a core mode of its current video model, with I2V credit pricing. Keyframes (up to 16 per clip) and character references let creators direct 'what changes and what holds,' which supports preserving the subject and composition from a still. A community report of morphing and weak temporal coherence in Dream Machine tempers confidence, but it is general and not a concrete I2V failure. Missing for 10: explicit documentation that I2V preserves the source image's subject and composition, and independent hands-on corroboration of that fidelity.
